grains.RAW.POND_DAILY: one row per pond per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.FEEDER_COVERAGE: one row per pond (auto-feeder coverage snapshot)

metrics.Feed Efficiency: SUM(BIOMASS_GAIN_KG) / SUM(FEED_TONNES) (kg biomass gain per tonne of feed)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.feed_refusal_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(feed-refusal event in next 7 days) per pond, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day grower-wide feed demand FORECAST; uneaten feed ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.FEED_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic feed-refusal response SOPs (one per species and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.FEED_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.FEED_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, feed-refusal, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (ponds with observations, daily feed uptake rate, feed-refusal events by pond, feed-refusal risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
